phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic portrait of Emine Mel'ait standing calm in a dusty server-temple. She wears heavy robes of earth tones and metallic weave. Her face features subtle golden circuit tattoos. She holds a black glass tablet against her chest. Lighting is moody and atmospheric with shafts of light cutting through dust. Photorealistic, intricate details, industrial mysticism style.
